topic: Body image and approval: training for compliments or likes puts our progress in other people's hands; the work is not worth less because nobody praised it
figure: Marcus Aurelius (Meditations 4.20: what is beautiful is beautiful in itself, and praise is no part of it, so it is made neither worse nor better by being praised; is an emerald made worse if it is not praised?). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request

lines: ไม่มีใครชมว่าหุ่นดีขึ้น
